description: A script for managing GitHub discussions and comments related to translation pull requests in a FastAPI project, including querying discussions, comments, and updating comments based on PR status.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a GitHub discussion comment with id, url, and body.

classes.name: UpdateDiscussionComment
classes.description: Wrapper for updating a discussion comment.

classes.name: UpdateCommentData
classes.description: Data model for update discussion comment response.

classes.name: UpdateCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for updating a comment.

classes.name: AddDiscussionComment
classes.description: Wrapper for adding a discussion comment.

classes.name: AddCommentData
classes.description: Data model for add discussion comment response.

classes.name: AddCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for adding a comment.

classes.name: CommentsEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in comments connection with node and cursor.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Contains list of comment edges.

classes.name: CommentsDiscussion
classes.description: Contains comments in a discussion.

classes.name: CommentsRepository
classes.description: Contains discussion comments in repository.

classes.name: CommentsData
classes.description: Data model for comments response.

classes.name: CommentsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model for comments API.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node in discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelsEdge
classes.description: Edge connecting to label node.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionLabels
classes.description: Labels associated with a discussion.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionNode
classes.description: Discussion node with title, id, number, labels.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussions
classes.description: Collection of discussion nodes.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsRepository
classes.description: Repository containing discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsData
classes.description: Top-level data model for discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Response model for discussions API.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the script, including GitHub repo, token, and environment.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEventIssue
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub pull request event with number.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEvent
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub event with optional pull request.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Executes a GraphQL request to GitHub API with provided query and variables, returns response data.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussions
methods.description: Fetches discussions related to translation category from GitHub.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments_edges
methods.description: Retrieves comment edges for a specific discussion.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments
methods.description: Retrieves all comments for a specific discussion, handling pagination.

methods.name: create_comment
methods.description: Creates a new comment in a discussion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that manages the process of commenting on translation PRs based on their status.
